Introduction

Yu Jiahn is a South Korean singer and rapper. In 2016, he was a contestant of the survival show BOYS24. He ranked 5th place and became a member of the final group SKYE (originally called IN2IT), whom he debuted with on October 26, 2017 with the mini album "Carpe Diem". In September of 2023 he debuted in the group's first subunit CoA, alongside fellow member Yeontae, with the release of the Japanese single "A New Beginning".

He also participated as a contestant on JTBC's 2024 survival show PROJECT7. However, he was eliminated in episode 11 after ranking 33rd place
